item.title: PlannetExpress - PG Practice
item.description: Summary: This is a cool vulnerable machine that illustrates PHP-FPM FastCGI vulnerability well. This PHP-FPM FastCGI vulnerability can be utilized to gain the initial foothold. And misconfigured SUID binary was used to escalate privileges. Enumeration Let’s First start with a nmap to find services running on the target machine nmap sudo nmap -Sc -sV -vv 192.168.120.158 --scripts=vulns,defaults -oN nmap/mull_ports -Pn -p- 22/tcp open ssh syn-ack OpenSSH 7.9p1 Debian 10+deb10u2 (protocol 2.
